title: IIns-VAE+: A Robust Transfer Learning Framework for Environmental Identification in Wireless Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2609.06131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Environmental identification in wireless sensing is essential for 6G integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems to achieve reliable situational awareness. However, deep learning (DL) models for this task often fail to generalize under domain shift across diverse environments. While the Inter-Instance Variational Auto-encoder (IIns-VAE) learns features of rich representation, its neural classifier remains vulnerable to these distribution changes. In this paper, we propose IIns-VAE+, a hybrid model that combines the IIns-VAE framework with Minimax Risk Classifiers (MRC) to improve adaptability in transfer learning scenarios. We use real-world datasets to evaluate our framework across three transfer learning scenarios, including general to specific room environments, high to low label resolutions, and mixed to specific environments. translated_title: IIns-VAE+：一种用于无线感知中环境识别的鲁棒迁移学习框架
translated_abstract: 无线感知中的环境识别对于6G通信感知一体化（ISAC）系统实现可靠的态势感知至关重要。然而，用于该任务的深度学习（DL）模型在跨不同环境的域偏移下往往难以泛化。虽然实例间变分自编码器能够学习到表示丰富的特征，但其神经分类器仍然容易受到这些分布变化的影响。在本文中，我们提出了IIns-VAE+，这是一种将IIns-VAE框架与极小化极大风险分类器相结合的混合模型，旨在提高迁移学习场景中的适应性。我们使用真实世界的数据集在三种迁移学习场景下评估了我们的框架，包括从通用到特定房间环境、从高到低标签分辨率、以及从混合到特定环境。实验结果表明，IIns-VAE+显著优于基线方法，展示了……
tldr: 本文提出IIns-VAE+混合模型，通过将实例间变分自编码器与极小化极大风险分类器相结合，显著提升了无线感知环境识别在多种跨环境迁移学习场景下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes IIns-VAE+, a hybrid model combining IIns-VAE with Minimax Risk Classifiers, which significantly improves robustness and generalization of environmental identification in wireless sensing across diverse transfer learning scenarios.
